comparison.basis: Reported consolidated net sales as presented together in Apple's FY2023 10-K.
scope_caveats: FY2023 spanned 53 weeks and FY2022 spanned 52 weeks. The comparison uses the reported totals for both periods.

evidence.scope_caveat: Apple disclosed that weaker foreign currencies accounted for more than the entire year-over-year decrease in total net sales.

notes.title: Summary of Significant Accounting Policies
notes.interpretation: The consolidation includes Apple and its wholly owned subsidiaries. Revenue excludes taxes remitted to governmental authorities. FY2023 had 53 weeks, while FY2022 and FY2021 had 52 weeks.

notes.title: Revenue
notes.interpretation: Revenue is recognized as control of products or services transfers. Product net sales reflect estimates of returns, price protection and other incentives.

notes.title: Segment Information and Geographic Data
notes.interpretation: Geographic segment net sales are supplemental disaggregation of reported consolidated net sales.
